doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

title: Opening: names, address and Paul Crawford on the recorder
summary: Allen opens the tape at 1619 North Galveston and has Billie, De De, Silver Trepagnier and Paul Crawford give their names.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: Get everybody to say something to give their names. Let's see. This is an interview being recorded. 1619 North Galveston. That's it, huh? Yeah. And it's in the back in Billy and the D's little house here. Yeah. And this is Dick Allen talking now. Billy, give me your name so we'll know what your voice sounds like.
My name is Willie Madison. Goodson Pierce.
Mm-hmm. And the D? Joseph Rockwell Pierce. But everybody called you the D, huh? Oh, the D, yeah.
What does that mean, anyhow? I don't know. It's just picking up some of the folks, I guess, on our demand.
And how do you spell the D?
D-E-D.
What's capitalized? What do you put in capitals?
Capitalized. The first D, D-E-E. D-E and small D in two E again. Mm-hmm. That's what it's called.
And your name now?
My name is Silver Tripanyay. 2307 Diabody Street. And you know, he's 19... What's your middle name now? Silver. Silver.
Silver.
Silver.
And you're no relation to the drummer, you just told... No relation to whatever, no.
But I'm new in it. I'm new in it. No relation to whatever. He's got a brother by the name of Frank Tripanyay, too. Is he around?
Yeah.
We ought to look him up. You know his address? No, but I could look at him for you.
Oh, good. Tell Billy and the D and they can phone me up. They got my phone number, huh?
Yeah. I got your phone number. Yeah, yeah.
Good. I wish I looked at him for you. Okay.
Well, now, let's see. Wait, I'm on here, too. Paul Crawford. Okay. I almost forgot Paul. I'm not going to be saying anything, but I want to be sure I'm on there.
That's right. Wait, Paul.
